items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: However, I have to say first, as we went to the rehearsal, he hadn't hired Kenny yet, and we rehearsed first without Kenny... Anyway, Ben borrowed some Dixieland arrangements from somebody, and we went in and we went to rehearsal... the band personnel started out, Buck Clayton on trumpet, Bennie Mor

ctx.x: And Bobby Rosengarden has a sizzle cymbal now, but originally Kenny took it around to the different drummers, and said, 'Hey, play this for me.'

It's nice to know that it became so prevalent because of you that they don't even demand their drummers to have it, they buy it and say to their drummers 'play this' and when they change drummers, they keep the cymbal so that whatever the next drummer comes in, it's ...
